children: Palm oil (FCPOc3) may break support at 4,799 ringgit per metric ton, and fall towards the 4,732-4,766 ringgit range.
A wave c from 4,964 ringgit has travelled below its 100% projection level of 4,820 ringgit. It is highly likely to extend to the range formed by the 161.8% and the 138.2% levels.
A break above 4,820 ringgit, now a resistance, may lead to a gain into the 4,840-4,854 ringgit range.
